fusions.name: Spore-Packed Jab
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Drifting Motes
fusions.desc: Looses 2 spore-laden stings; each one deals 3 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. [Diseased] then finds up to 2 more enemies within 5 tiles on its own.

fusions.name: Paper Puffball
fusions.desc: Sets a spore-packed paper nest on the ground for 20 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set it off, and its blast deals 18 damage around it.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all burst at once in a blow that deals 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
